subject: include final page item in inclusive range check
body_md:
`itemsInRange` was using a strict less-than against `range.end`, which silently dropped the item at the upper bound of every page. The `PageRange` contract treats `end` as inclusive, so the loop now uses `<=`.

A regression test pins the new behavior: a range `{ start: 1, end: 3 }` over four items must return three items, not two.
_note: Reference output for conformance checks. LLM outputs vary; treat this as a quality target, not a strict assertion. Acceptable variations: subject wording, body phrasing, confidence within +/- 0.1.
